sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/103 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 103, grids and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sampled units on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12; grids for 2027-01-12; read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $41 a night; full hookups $56; the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) electric and full-hookup $37. The 13 non-electric sites ($33, off-peak $29) are tent-only, so they don't set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Hocking Hills campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 41.00, Full Hookup 56.00, Non-Electric 33.00 with IsRVSite false and 'Tents only on non-electric sites'); units 001, 024 and 081 on Sat 2027-06-19 (41.00 / 56.00 / 33.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (37.00 / 37.00 / 29.00), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/hocking-hills-state-park-campground ('full hook-up sites, electric sites with 20-, 30- or 50-amp service') + ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '20,30,50 amp'; the 44 full-hookup sites list water and sewer hookups), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 145 web-bookable RV sites, all back-in on paved pads: 101 electric (27-43 ft) and 44 full hookup (28-44 ft), spread over about 1.2 km south of the visitor center. Plus 13 tent-only non-electric sites, three Sherman cabins, a hike-in campground, and tent-only group camps. Pets permitted on all campsites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid + search/details (IsRVSite true on 145 electric/full-hookup units, Pad Length 27-44, PullInTypeName 'Back In') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/hocking-hills-state-park-campground ('Each site has a paved pad', 'Pets are permitted on all campsites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Heated showers; year-round dump and fill station; campground store (740) 385-6842. Outdoor pool Memorial Day - Labor Day. Off-peak (November 1 - April 1) Shower House 1, the dump station and the store stay open; water only at Shower House 1.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/hocking-hills-state-park-campground ('Heated showers, flush toilets, laundry, year-round dump station and fill station', 'Campground Store Phone: (740) 385-6842', 'Off-Peak Season (November 1 - April 1) ...'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 - April 1 with reduced facilities. ReserveOhio sells sites 1-93 (71 electric and full-hookup) for a January night; sites 94-172 are not sold then.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/hocking-hills-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season (November 1 - April 1)') + ReserveOhio grids for 2027-01-12 (Camp Sites 1-93: 27 electric + 44 full hookup free; Camp Sites 94-172: none), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations for full hookup, electric, or non-electric sites may be made up to six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

note:
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Hocking Hills State Park campground on the plateau beside Old Man's Cave and the visitor center, with trail access to the gorge. --Claude
summary: Fees changed 33 (+8 electric, +23 full hookup) -> 41 (+15 full hookup): the $33 non-electric sites are tent-only. Added hookups 50/W/S, 145 back-in RV sites to 44 ft, showers/flush/laundry/dump/water/store, year-round season, ReserveOhio booking (180 days, max 14). Note: kept the recommendation line verbatim; dropped 'not directly on a water body' (waterfront field).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (740) 385-6842 (campground/store).

Pin 235 m north of the nearest RV site and 670 m from the RV-site centroid (39.4315,-82.5380); the loops run about 1.2 km south from the visitor center (sites 39-70 at 39.425-39.428,-82.541). A mid-campground pin near 39.4325,-82.5378 would sit among the sites.
